note: Primary = sop_strict (unchanged; the user chooses after the improvement round). os2_fixed and original are sensitivity analyses; the sop_strict_v2 family is the pre-registered improvement round.

configs.original: Sensitivity analysis: engine as published before 2026-09-24 (any direction-supporting CIViC item -> OS2 if level A/B else legacy 'OM4').
configs.os2_fixed: Sensitivity analysis: original engine with only the CIViC->OS2 mapping fixed (functional evidence only; OM4 per SOP, unassigned).
configs.sop_strict: SOP-strict (primary): Horak 2022 Tables 2-3 incl. exclusion rules; OP4 only from observed gnomAD data; OM1 only at UniProt active/binding sites; CIViC functional evidence only; no non-SOP guards.
configs.sop_strict_v2: SOP-strict v2 (candidate primary, pre-registered): sop_strict + OP1/SBP1 only when all utilised lines agree (AlphaMissense, REVEL, CADD at ClinGen supporting thresholds) + SBVS1/SBS1 on the maximum of the 5 SOP continental gnomAD populations + CIViC monthly release and pre-registered MaveDB DMS sets.
configs.sop_strict_v2_5pred: Sensitivity S-a1: v2 with SIFT and PolyPhen-2 added to the all-agree predictor set (Pejaver 2022 thresholds).
configs.sop_strict_v2_revel: Sensitivity S-a2: v2 with OP1/SBP1 from REVEL alone (Pejaver 2022 single calibrated tool recommendation).
configs.sop_strict_v2_devcut: Sensitivity S-a3: v2 with developer cut-offs (AlphaMissense 0.564/0.34, REVEL 0.5, CADD 20).
configs.sop_strict_v2_om1domain: Sensitivity S-d: v2 with the broader domain-level OM1 reading (exclusions kept).
configs.abl_strict_plus_a0: Ablation: sop_strict + AlphaMissense at ClinGen thresholds only (single line).
configs.abl_strict_plus_b: Ablation: sop_strict + change b (continental max AF).
